title: FX Brief — 18 Sep 2026
intro:
Broad-based USD strength driven by persistent JPY weakness as yen crosses surge across the board amid unwinding safe-haven flows.
💪 CURRENCY RANKING
1. AUD +0.39% — Commodity resilience and relative yield support despite broader USD gains
2. USD +0.17% — Safe-haven demand waning but dollar remains well-bid on rate differentials
3. CAD +0.10% — Oil-linked strength partially offsetting greenback momentum
4. EUR -0.01% — Holding ground at 1.1469 but lacking conviction amid ECB dovish bias
5. CHF -0.05% — Neutral trading as SNB policy uncertainty caps franc gains
6. NZD -0.15% — Underperforming Antipodean peer on softer dairy prices and risk-off undertones
7. GBP -0.27% — Sterling weakness intensifies on BoE rate cut speculation and fiscal concerns
8. JPY -1.13% — Worst performer as USD/JPY breaks 157.80; intervention risks rising but BoJ remains passive
